# Comfy Apply Glitch And Distortion Effects

Adds customizable glitch and tearing effects to images. Control distortion intensity, chromatic aberration, and pattern randomness. Outputs a stylistically distorted image. Runs on Comfy Cloud and needs a COMFY_API_KEY.

**How it works:** The Comfy nodes form the complete template graph. Run submits the graph to Comfy Cloud and saves its outputs.

**Try this:** Change the prompt or the Load node inputs and run again to compare results.

Source: https://github.com/Comfy-Org/workflow_templates/blob/1ae390968e323dba24a6991d1860ded051f5a79b/templates/templates_purz_image_glitch.json (MIT). Model licenses apply separately.
